structures.name: Superior Colliculus
structures.about: The rostral pair of swellings on the roof of the midbrain, involved in visual reflexes and orienting.

structures.name: Cerebral Aqueduct
structures.about: The narrow channel through the midbrain connecting the third and fourth ventricles.

structures.name: Tegmentum
structures.about: The core of the midbrain beneath the colliculi, carrying cranial nerve nuclei and ascending and descending tracts.
